questions.question_english: Which of the following best defines an operating system?

questions.explanation_english: An operating system functions as fundamental system software that manages hardware components and provisions critical resources for application software execution. Additionally, it offers core services like process scheduling, user authentication, security controls, and file management to maintain seamless operational efficiency across computing platforms.
